name: splendor-promo
description: Splendor Family Edition — 54-second promo, Chinese and English cuts

scripts.gen: npm run gen:data && npm run gen:audio && npm run gen:bgm && npm run gen:fonts
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts SplendorPromoZH out/splendor-promo-zh-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=19 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && node scripts/master.mjs zh
scripts.render:en: remotion render src/index.ts SplendorPromoEN out/splendor-promo-en-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=19 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && node scripts/master.mjs en
